problems.title: Balance a score sheet
problems.statement: Return the first index where the sum strictly before it equals the sum strictly after it; return -1 if none exists.
problems.constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 100000; integer values with absolute value ≤ 10000.
problems.hint: Track the remaining sum while scanning.
problems.editorial: Subtract the current value from the right sum, compare with the left sum, then add the current value to the left sum.

reference.python:
def solve(scores):
    r=sum(scores)
    l=0
    for i,x in enumerate(scores):
        r-=x
        if l==r: return i
        l+=x
    return -1

problems.title: Stable event deduplication
problems.statement: Remove repeated integer IDs, keeping the first occurrence in original order.
problems.hint: Keep a set of seen IDs.
problems.editorial: Append only the first occurrence of each ID.

problems.title: First unique event
problems.statement: Return the first integer appearing exactly once, or null (Python None) if no such integer exists.
problems.editorial: Build a frequency map, then scan in the original order.

problems.title: First qualifying measurement
problems.statement: Given a sorted nondecreasing array and threshold, return the first index with value at least the threshold, or -1 if none exists.
problems.editorial: Maintain a half-open interval. Discard the left half when its midpoint is below the threshold; otherwise retain the midpoint.

reference.python:
def solve(values, threshold):
    l,r=0,len(values)
    while l<r:
        m=(l+r)//2
        if values[m]<threshold: l=m+1
        else: r=m
    return l if l<len(values) else -1

problems.title: Validate bracket configuration
problems.statement: Return whether a string of brackets ()[]{} is correctly matched and nested.
problems.hint: Keep unmatched openers on a stack.
problems.editorial: Push openers and compare each closer to the last opener. The stack must end empty.

problems.title: Longest unique token span
problems.statement: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring containing no repeated characters.
problems.hint: Track the last index of each character.
problems.editorial: Advance the left edge past any repeat inside the current window. Track the maximum length.

problems.title: Peak traffic window
problems.statement: Return the largest sum of any contiguous block of exactly k integer measurements.
problems.constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000; values may be negative; absolute value ≤ 10000.
problems.editorial: Compute the first window, then subtract the outgoing element and add the incoming one.

reference.python:
def solve(values, k):
    s=sum(values[:k])
    b=s
    for i in range(k,len(values)):
        s+=values[i]-values[i-k]
        b=max(b,s)
    return b

problems.title: Next higher alert
problems.statement: For each integer reading, return the distance to the first strictly higher reading to its right, or zero if none exists.
problems.editorial: Maintain a decreasing stack; a higher reading resolves smaller readings on top of it.

problems.title: Minimum network hops
problems.statement: Given n undirected nodes numbered 0 to n-1, edges and start/target nodes, return the shortest path length in edges or -1 if unreachable.
problems.editorial: Build adjacency lists and visit unseen neighbors in queue order, recording the distance.

problems.title: Validate job dependencies
problems.statement: Given n jobs and directed edges [a,b] indicating a precedes b, return whether all jobs can finish without a dependency cycle.
problems.editorial: Remove jobs of zero indegree and decrement their neighbors. All jobs must be removed.

problems.title: Minimum payment tokens
problems.statement: Return the smallest number of positive-denomination tokens making amount, allowing reuse, or -1 if impossible.
problems.hint: Build optimal answers for smaller amounts.
problems.editorial: Initialize dp[0]=0, use an impossible sentinel elsewhere, and try each denomination that fits.

problems.title: Non-adjacent reward selection
problems.statement: Maximize the sum of a subset of non-adjacent integer rewards. Choosing no positions is allowed.
problems.hint: Compare taking a reward with skipping it.
problems.editorial: Keep two rolling states: best through the preceding position, and best through two positions earlier.

problems.title: Shared ordered signal
problems.statement: Return the length of the longest common subsequence of two ASCII strings. Characters need not be contiguous.
problems.hint: Define a state for each pair of prefixes.
problems.editorial: Match extends the diagonal state; otherwise choose the greater adjacent state. Keep two rows.

problems.title: Minimum text correction
problems.statement: Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions or substitutions needed to transform ASCII string a into b.
problems.editorial: For a match use the diagonal state. Otherwise add one to the minimum of insertion, deletion and substitution states.

problems.title: Largest storage rectangle
problems.statement: Given nonnegative histogram heights of unit-width bars, return the largest rectangular area contained in consecutive bars.
problems.hint: Find when a bar can no longer extend right.
problems.editorial: Keep an increasing stack with a trailing zero. When popping a taller bar, compute its maximal width using the new stack top.

reference.python:
def solve(heights):
    h=heights+[0]
    s=[]
    best=0
    for i,x in enumerate(h):
        while s and h[s[-1]]>x:
            v=h[s.pop()]
            l=s[-1] if s else -1
            best=max(best,v*(i-l-1))
        s.append(i)
    return best

problems.title: Count staircase routes
problems.statement: Count distinct ways to reach step n using steps of size 1 or 2. Return 1 for n=0.
problems.hint: The last move has size one or two.
problems.editorial: Use the Fibonacci recurrence with one way to reach step zero and step one.

reference.python:
def solve(n):
    a=b=1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,a+b
    return a
